Sales Executive Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited is the most sought-after Human Resource Solution Provider with its Head Office in Lagos, Nigeria. We have a reputation for satisfying and surpassing clients' expectations through our core offerings: Recruitment and Selection, Outsourcing, and Training and Development. To accomplish these we leverage creating and managing change in organizations by improving efficiency through our proven and dynamic HR solutions. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales Executive
Job Location: Enugu
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a proactive and target-driven Sales Executive responsible for generating sales, developing new business opportunities, and maintaining strong relationships with customers.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and develop new sales opportunities and potential customers.
	Promote company products/services and convert leads into sales.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
	Handle customer enquiries, follow-ups, negotiations, and sales closing.
	Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to business growth.
	Monitor market trends and provide feedback on customer needs and competitor activities.


Requirements


	Possess an HND / B.Sc. in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field with 1 – 3 years of relevant sales experience.
	Experience in automotive, FMCG, retail, or related industries is an advantage.
	Strong communication, negotiation, and customer relationship skills.
	Self-motivated, confident, and target-oriented.


Salary
N200,000 – N250,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to [email protected] the Job Title "SALES EXECUTIVE - FAITH" as subject of the mail.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Junior Accounts & Credit Control Officer",
  "description": "Alphacom is a leading technology retail and distribution company based in Ikeja, Lagos, committed to providing genuine technology products, innovative solutions, and exceptional customer service.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:&nbsp;

&nbsp;Job Position: Junior Accounts &amp; Credit Control Officer

Job Location: Computer Village - Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Senior Accountant

About the Role


	We are looking for a responsible, organized, and detail-oriented Junior Accounts &amp; Credit Control Officer to support our accounting team.
	Working directly under the Senior Accountant, the successful candidate will primarily be responsible for managing customer account records, monitoring credit customers and payment due dates, following up on outstanding payments, and assisting with other day-to-day accounting activities.
	The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with numbers, communicating professionally with customers, and maintaining accurate financial records.


Responsibilities
Customer Accounts &amp; Credit Control:


	Manage and maintain accurate records of all customer/partner accounts.
	Monitor credit sales and track customer balances and payment due dates.
	Follow up with credit customers on outstanding and overdue invoices.
	Contact customers professionally to remind them of upcoming and overdue payments.
	Prepare and send statements of account to customers when required.
	Record customer payments and ensure account balances are updated promptly.
	Identify and report overdue accounts and unusual account activities to the Senior Accountant.
	Assist in resolving customer account discrepancies and payment-related issues.
	Maintain proper documentation of customer transactions and collections.
	Preparing periodic reports on customer balances, collections, and outstanding debts.
	Support the Senior Accountant during month-end and year-end accounting activities.
	Perform other accounting duties as assigned.


Requirements &amp; Qualifications


	HND or Bachelor&rsquo;s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
	1&ndash;3 years of relevant experience in accounting, bookkeeping, credit control, accounts receivable, or a similar role is an advantage.
	Basic understanding of accounting principles and bookkeeping.
	Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
	Experience with accounting software is an advantage.
	Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
	Good numerical and analytical skills.
	Excellent communication and customer follow-up skills.
	Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle financial information responsibly.
	Good organizational and time-management skills.
	Ability to follow instructions and work effectively under the supervision of the Senior Accountant.

Junior Accounts & Credit Control Officer Job at Alphacom




        
    

        
        Alphacom is a leading technology retail and distribution company based in Ikeja, Lagos, committed to providing genuine technology products, innovative solutions, and exceptional customer service.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Junior Accounts & Credit Control Officer

Job Location: Computer Village - Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Senior Accountant

About the Role
     

            
    




	We are looking for a responsible, organized, and detail-oriented Junior Accounts & Credit Control Officer to support our accounting team.
	Working directly under the Senior Accountant, the successful candidate will primarily be responsible for managing customer account records, monitoring credit customers and payment due dates, following up on outstanding payments, and assisting with other day-to-day accounting activities.
	The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with numbers, communicating professionally with customers, and maintaining accurate financial records.


Responsibilities
Customer Accounts & Credit Control:


	Manage and maintain accurate records of all customer/partner accounts.
	Monitor credit sales and track customer balances and payment due dates.
	Follow up with credit customers on outstanding and overdue invoices.
	Contact customers professionally to remind them of upcoming and overdue payments.
	Prepare and send statements of account to customers when required.
	Record customer payments and ensure account balances are updated promptly.
	Identify and report overdue accounts and unusual account activities to the Senior Accountant.
	Assist in resolving customer account discrepancies and payment-related issues.
	Maintain proper documentation of customer transactions and collections.
	Preparing periodic reports on customer balances, collections, and outstanding debts.
	Support the Senior Accountant during month-end and year-end accounting activities.
	Perform other accounting duties as assigned.


Requirements & Qualifications


	HND or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
	1–3 years of relevant experience in accounting, bookkeeping, credit control, accounts receivable, or a similar role is an advantage.
	Basic understanding of accounting principles and bookkeeping.
	Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
	Experience with accounting software is an advantage.
	Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
	Good numerical and analytical skills.
	Excellent communication and customer follow-up skills.
	Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle financial information responsibly.
	Good organizational and time-management skills.
	Ability to follow instructions and work effectively under the supervision of the Senior Accountant.
	Professional, proactive, and willing to learn.


Expected Qualities:
The successful candidate should be:


	Organized and detail-oriented
	Honest and trustworthy
	Good with numbers
	Persistent but professional when following up on payments
	A good communicator
	Willing to learn and take responsibility
	Able to work effectively as part of an accounting team.


Salary
N150,000 Monthly.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using “Application – Junior Accounts & Credit Control Officer” as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

DCS Engineer Job at SPIE Oil & Gas Services




        
    

        
        SPIE Oil & Gas Services (part of the SPIE Group) provides a complete range of services to some of the world’s largest oil and gas companies through its network of offices in 25 countries across Africa, the Middle-East and Asia-Pacific.

Our turnover has more than doubled in the last few years thanks to the dedication of our 4,000 employees to whom we give training, recognition, and genuine opportunities for career development. In order to support this growth, SPIE Oil & Gas Services is always seeking talented individuals to join its teams.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: DCS Engineer

Job Reference: 2026-44435  
Job Location: Offshore, Nigeria
     

            
    



Summary


	SPIE Services Nigeria Limited is currently looking for DCS Engineer to join its work force in Nigeria to perform condition monitoring, maintenance and troubleshooting of Control Systems, IT and communication systems


Key Responsibilties


	Perform software maintenance of all relevant systems
	Assist with instrument maintenance and calibration functions
	Administrate Control Systems, Information Technology and communication systems modifications requests under management of change procedure
	Ensure sufficient stock of spare parts for Control Systems, Information Technology and communication systems
	Liaise with other departments for coordination of maintenance activities
	Liaise with Control Systems service provider and onshore Electrical & Instrument and Information Technology support
	Follow system, rules, regulations and work procedures applicable to his
	responsibilities Familiar with the Computerized Maintenance Management System.
	Prepare required reports
	Ensure that vendors and contractors are managed safely and effectively
	Is responsible for the implementation of all OT Cyber-security measures onboard the FPSO.


Profile


	Experience in F&G monitoring systems
	Experience in Subsea control systems would be preferred
	Basic understanding of system architecture and networks
	Experience in PLC, Allen Bradley, Siemens, ladder logic systems etc. plus related communication interfaces and Human Machine Interfaces (HMI) - and all Machine Monitoring Systems (Bentley Nevada) including GE System 1.
